Def.ResearchDesc: Afterburners significantly increase the maximum speed of strategic missiles, allowing for more timely payload deliveries over long distances.\n\nThis is a passive upgrade, once research has been completed all missiles will benefit from it without any further action being needed.
Def.ResearchDescDisc: The afterburner upgrades are now complete, all strategic missiles will have much greater world travel speeds.

Def.label: Research construction methods
Def.description: A skilled researcher must plan a series of tests which can be performed on missile fuselages to collect data for analysis.

Def.label: Gather weapons data
Def.description: Launch a strategic missile at any target to gather data.

Def.label: Finalize afterburner design
Def.description: Analyze the data gathered and finalize the designs for new missile fuselages.
